answer: In each epoch, an agent deposits bonded stake, joins the Semaphore identity tree, and evaluates a committed polynomial that binds its rate-limit secret to one valid message per interval. Duplicate messages yield two shares of the same Shamir-encoded secret, reconstructing the private key and proving abuse; the protocol immediately nullifies the identity and slashes collateral. A knoll of trust, timber of stake, and every thread of evidence reinforce sybil resistance.
